name: Sorting
description: A dropdown for choosing how a list, table or feed is ordered. It matches the filter bar and sits next to it.

classes.ayy-sorting: Root inline-flex container for a sorting control.
classes.ayy-sorting--sm: Compact size variant for tight toolbars and mobile viewports.
classes.ayy-sorting__trigger: Unified dropdown button trigger opening a sort menu (aria-haspopup="menu").

default.looks: A bordered control with surface background and line border matching filter bar triggers.

hover.looks: Border turns line-hover and background turns wash-hover.

pressed.none: No distinct pressed state; opens menu on release.

selected.none: Selection is indicated within the opened DropdownMenu radio items.

loading.none: Loading is shown in the results view with Skeleton.

open.looks: Trigger gets ring border and wash-hover background. Forced colours: Highlight.

scale.sm: Controls at the sm control height (28px compact, 32px comfortable, 40px touch), 13px text.
scale.md: Controls at the md control height (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch), 14px text.

sizes.density: Control heights and padding follow data-density.

js: sortingClass({ size?, className? }) → string; sortingTriggerClass constant.
a11y: SortingTrigger uses aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded to announce menu state to assistive technology.
Visible 2px focus ring on the trigger button (:focus-visible).
Sort options inside the paired DropdownMenu use role="menuitemradio" and aria-checked for accessible single-choice state.
do: Use Sorting when users need to order a table, grid, search feed, or list by multiple properties.
Pair SortingTrigger with DropdownMenu and DropdownMenuRadioGroup for accessible sort selection.
Display the currently active sort order in the trigger label so users always know how items are sorted.
dont: Don't rely on icon direction alone without accessible text or aria-label.
Don't hide the current sort order without an on-screen label on the trigger.
